meta.title: Delivery Date Rules for Transit Time

nodes.label: Maintain ERP Transit Time Table
nodes.note: Cadence: per request. Feeds the Promised Date. Tool: ERP.

nodes.label: Maintain Forwarder Transit Time Table
nodes.note: Cadence: per request. Feeds the Shipment ASN Expected Receipt Date. Consulted: Booking Agent. Tool: Supplier Portal.

nodes.label: Update production end date on PO
nodes.note: The latest confirmed production end date. Tool: Supplier Portal.

nodes.label: Update Supplier Ex-Factory Date
nodes.note: Some markets derive it automatically from the production end date plus a fixed lead time; in the others the vendor updates it manually on the PO.

nodes.label: ERP auto-calculates Promised Date
nodes.note: Promised Date = Supplier Ex-Factory Date + pre-carriage days + ERP transit time + goods-receipt days, for all ship modes.

nodes.label: Enter actual Ex-Factory Date in Packing List
nodes.note: Source document banner before this step: from here on, the Supplier Ex-Factory Date comes from the actual date in the Packing List. The date flows from the Supplier Portal to the ERP purchase order, and the ERP recalculates the Promised Date.

nodes.label: Invoice status = Active?
nodes.note: Entered when the vendor typed a wrong Supplier Ex-Factory Date in the Packing List. The source table documents only the two correction branches; it draws no route for the case where the date is correct, so that path is absent here too. This step and its two branches restate exception scenario 1 ('Key date wrong after invoice generation') as normal flow.

nodes.label: Reopen Packing List and correct the date
nodes.note: Cadence: per exception — exception scenario 1. Invoice status is not 'Active', so the Packing List stays editable.

nodes.label: Wait for Shipment ASN Expected Receipt Date
nodes.note: Cadence: per exception — exception scenario 1. Invoice status is 'Active', so the Packing List is locked and the key date cannot be corrected there.

nodes.label: Ship Mode = Ocean?
nodes.note: Source document banner before this step: from here on, stop following the Promised Date and start following the Expected Receipt Date. Once the shipment is on board, the Expected Receipt Date flows from the Shipment ASN and its source depends on the ship mode.

nodes.label: Send Shipping Advice to Supplier Portal
nodes.note: Ocean. The Supplier Portal populates the Shipment ASN Expected Receipt Date as the ETA at the port of discharge plus the forwarder's transit time from the port to the DC. Accountable: Global Logistics. Consulted: Vendor.

nodes.label: Flip Packing List to Shipment ASN using ETA
nodes.note: Air, Truck, Parcel: no Shipping Advice is sent; the Supplier Portal converts the Packing List into the Shipment ASN and the Expected Receipt Date is taken from the Packing List ETA — at the destination airport for Air, at the destination DC for Truck and Parcel. Accountable: Global Logistics.

nodes.label: New date outside the tolerance window?
nodes.note: Recalculated for all markets when the new value differs from the current value by more than the agreed tolerance. Tool: ERP.

nodes.label: Keep Expected Receipt Date
nodes.note: Change within the tolerance, so the Expected Receipt Date is not updated.

nodes.label: Update Expected Receipt Date
nodes.note: Change outside the tolerance, so the Expected Receipt Date is updated.

nodes.label: Record Actual Receipt Date
nodes.note: Goods receipt date on receipt at destination. Informed: Market Finance. Tool: ERP.
